title: Option: a value or no value

questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Option: a value or no value”?
options: Rust bindings are immutable unless declared mut.
`Some(7)` and `None` take different branches; `match` checks every case.
Cargo is the main tool for creating, building, and testing projects.
Obtain the installer from rust-lang.org and install native prerequisites only for the target you need.
questions.answer: `Some(7)` and `None` take different branches; `match` checks every case.
questions.explanation:
`Some(7)` and `None` take different branches; `match` checks every case.
Why: Sometimes a value is missing. Rust represents that openly with `Option<T>`: `Some(value)` means present and `None` means absent. `match` or `if let` makes you handle both cases, which is useful for a missing list item or optional user input.
